def is_safe_path(base_path, user_input_path):
    # Normalize the paths
    base_path = os.path.abspath(base_path)
    user_input_path = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(base_path, user_input_path))

    # Check if the user input path starts with the base path
    return user_input_path.startswith(base_path)
